VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.108

  • Bounds Powerhouse prewarm concurrency so readiness work no longer spawns duplicate OpenAI/Cerebras probes or oversized local voice worker fleets.
  • Caps HF realtime sidecar pool and thread defaults while keeping the selected local voice runtime warm.
  • Switches new installs to Balanced Powerhouse mode by default and keeps memory pressure as telemetry instead of a readiness blocker.
  • Fixes the Powerhouse worker limiter so configured concurrency limits are actually honored.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.107

  • Restarts the local LaunchAgent automatically when diagnostics find the bridge down on localhost.
  • Keeps the Companion Realtime Voice streaming sidecar hot with boot bursts, periodic profile warmups, and websocket heartbeats.
  • Raises LaunchAgent thread, HF pipeline, and runtime environment defaults for more aggressive realtime readiness.
  • Runs Powerhouse startup warmup with heavier parallel sidecar, TTS, route, and network preparation.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.106

  • Raises Powerhouse thread defaults and worker ceilings for much more aggressive CPU/GPU/silicon utilization.
  • Runs all Companion Realtime Voice HF sidecar profiles in repeated concurrent warm bursts instead of staged primary/fallback warmup.
  • Increases TTS, route, and network warm probes so the Mac converges faster toward a hot realtime appliance state.
